messages:
DeployBot: Canary deploy v2026.3.7 -> canary-1 complete. Running post-deploy smoke suite: healthcheck, synth-egress, kv-prefix. Results will follow.
Sam: saw a few failing synth-egress checks already, 502-ish. Not yet sure if transient.
Lina: confirmed, dashboards show spike on canary-1 egress latency to model-fetch endpoint (10s+). Other canaries are fine.
Ravi: stacktrace from canary logs: `error=timeout dialing external-model-host:443` repeated. Could be NAT gateway egress rules or SNAT exhaustion.
Marcos: rolling a quick `curl` against internal metadata from the canary instance: `curl -sS -D - http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/` -> times out
OpsBot: Alert: synth-egress probe failed 17/20 attempts for canary-1 (rate 0.85) — auto-pause threshold reached.
Sam: Can we pin traffic back to v2026.3.6 for now? We should stop the rollout until we confirm networking.
Lina: Agree. Also let's disable autoscaler while we investigate to avoid making it worse.
Ravi: I can open a quick firewall rule check — suspected change in egress NAT pool after infra deploy earlier today. Looking at terraform diff now.
Marcos: Temporary mitigation: `kubectl annotate svc/edge-proxy rollout-pause=true` and `redwoodctl traffic set canary-1=0 canary-0=100` (manual pin to previous canary)
Sam: Doing the `redwoodctl` pin now. Pinned to v2026.3.6. Will verify smoke again.
DeployBot: Traffic pin action applied by Sam at 1767777805. Post-action: synth-egress success 20/20 on canary-0, healthchecks green.
Lina: Thanks. Ravi, keep us posted on terraform findings. If NAT pool change is the root, rolling back infra will need a change window.
Ravi: Found it — a scaling tweak to the shared NAT gateway decreased available SNAT ports. Reverting that change now.
OpsBot: Infra rollback started by Ravi at 1767777890.
Marcos: Action items: 1) Confirm infra rollback completes and run full smoke suite (Sam). 2) Add egress SNAT monitoring + alert (Marcos). 3) Add `egress-probe` to pre-rollout checks to catch this in CI (Lina).
Sam: Will re-run smoke suite and reopen rollout once stable. Leaving the thread for postmortem notes.
DeployBot: Marking rollout paused. If infra rollback completes and smoke is green, requeue canary at next deploy window. :white_check_mark:
